description: The free-cash-flow growth a share price implies: solves a discounted cash flow model for the growth that reaches the market's enterprise value, from the company's annual XBRL and the last close, with a sensitivity table and the company's own history beside it.

base.description: Base free cash flow: the latest year (default) or the last three years' average, which smooths an unusual year.

discount_rate.description: Yearly discount rate (cost of capital); default 0.09.

terminal_growth.description: Growth for ever after the forecast years; default 0.025.

ticker.description: The ticker to price, when company is a CIK without one (a predecessor filer).

years.description: Forecast years of the implied growth; default 10.

name: reverse_dcf

outputSchema.description: implied_growth is a yearly rate (0.12 = 12%); sensitivity rows are discount rates, columns terminal growth.

title: Reverse DCF (implied growth)
